name: DOF Gaussian Rasterization
definition: A differentiable rasterization method for 3D Gaussians that supports adjustable depth-of-field, enabling refocusing, defocus rendering, and blur removal by incorporating circle-of-confusion (CoC) alpha and depth-dependent scaling.
summary: DOF Gaussian Rasterization is a differentiable 3D Gaussian Splatting method that enables adjustable depth-of-field by using circle-of-confusion alpha to decouple focus from the camera center.
